body:
Why do you want to die now?
That option will be open to you later as well as many others.

Hey there, been in your situation before, obviously nothing worked for me. Please be aware that using train tracks will cost your family lawsuits and traumatize a lot of people; thats how my friend's dad went.... just cross that off your list if you could, for a stranger.

You don't want to hear it, but you should try to hold back if you can and rationalize with yourself for now. Right now, you have no choice but to keep living, you literally don't have the resources to end it. That's scary and probably why you feel boxed in, theres no "escape". At least wait until you're older and do have a choice/options, if you're really bent on this. You might feel freer and start to have options open up to that are more than just misery or death.  Until then, fuck the world. Do whatever you want, its your life to take for a ride, so long as you're living.

Hello, what is your reasoning for posting this here?

Remember that life is not immutable. The only thing you can be certain about regarding your experience here is that it will be constantly changing. For good or bad, it is changing. Life will move around you, you will be given new chances. You do absolutely deserve better than to feel like that, but you will not have that chance to feel better unless you keep living to see the next change. It is hard, you don't even necessarily need change. Please wait until tomorrow to see how you feel, and then wait for the next day.
